subject: Renewal & capacity uplift — vendor onboarding + PO fast lane
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal refresh & capacity uplift — what we need from Redwood

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Hope you’re both well. We’re starting formal renewal discussions for our Redwood contract (current term ends 2029-06-30). We’d like to: 1) move to a 24-month term, 2) increase committed capacity by ~40% (estimate: additional 300k tokens/month committed), and 3) refresh our vendor onboarding record in your procurement portal — procurement wants the portal record to match the new billing cadence.

Attached is our procurement checklist (Acme_renewal_requirements_20290515.pdf) and a short note on timing: legal needs final SOW by 2029-05-24 to get PO approved by 2029-05-31. Can you confirm the fastest path for: SOW update, portal onboarding refresh, and PO submission? We may need a temporary invoice cadence change while the portal is updated.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp
alice.chen@acme-corp.com
+1 415-555-0136
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal refresh & capacity uplift — what we need from Redwood

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear timing.

High-level plan (fast lane):
- Today (15 May): I’ll attach an updated SOW draft with the 24-month term + capacity uplift. (SOW_Redwood_Acme_v2.pdf attached)
- 16–17 May: Jordan will create/update the vendor record in our procurement portal and share the vendor invite link and the checklist that Acme needs to complete.
- 20–24 May: Capture signatures (DocuSign) and Acme uploads PO into portal.
- 31 May: Accounting issues the invoice cadence change and confirms effective date.

Ben, Jordan — can you own the portal lane and DocuSign flow? Alice — we’ll mark one onboarding credit for the portal refresh (to speed the approval) and note it in the SOW.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal invite + checklist (action: complete by 21 May)

Hi Alice — looping in the vendor portal team. Per Marissa’s note, I’ve started a vendor record for Acme and sent a portal invite to procure@acme-corp.com. Link below.

Portal quick steps (estimated 20–30 minutes):
1) Accept the invite and create the vendor admin account.
2) Upload W-9 (or local equivalent), signed contract (SOW), and bank remittance form.
3) Fill in contact + billing cadence (we recommend NET30 unless you need prepaid).
4) Attach PO (once approved) to the vendor record and set the effective start date.

Required evidence: W-9, SOC2 attestation copy (if you have one), bank remittance form, signed SOW. I attached a short checklist for Procurement (Vendor_Checklist_Portal.pdf).

Portal invite: https://redwood-portal.example.com/vendor-onboard?token=inv-8520
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-8891

If you prefer, Ben can accept a PO by email and I’ll route it to accounting manually — but using the portal will speed the payment and tie to the new billing cadence.

-Jordan
Solution Ops, Redwood Inference

Alice — quick answers:
1) SOW pricing model: yes — the attached SOW (SOW_Redwood_Acme_v2.pdf) includes: committed per-token price for months 1–12, a floor-priced tier for months 13–24, and an overage rate. We’ll add a clean pricing table in the final SOW for legal.
2) Fallback for PO: we can accept a scanned PO to billing@redwood.com with a PO number and reference RDW-ACME-2029Q2-EXPAND. Accounting will process the scanned PO and Jordan will retro-link it in the portal once your team uploads it.

If you can complete the portal upload by EOD tomorrow (21 May), accounting will guarantee NET30 terms with the new effective date the day after the PO is attached. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the scanned-PO fallback so you don’t miss your approval window.
